value.title: Re:Zero - Starting Break Time from Zero: Otto and Subaru's Resolve
value.synopsis: It's a daily routine in the Sanctuary. Subaru and Ram's bickering, Emilia's helplessness, and Otto's worry and determination.

value.title: Re:Zero - Starting Break Time from Zero: Fang of Iron Report - 2
value.synopsis: Ricardo expresses his dissatisfaction with Mimi's inaction, but Mimi and Anastasia remain calm. Yurius asks Anastasia some questions about the merchant.

value.title: Re:Zero - Starting Break Time from Zero: Otto's Diary - 8
value.synopsis: Otto's diary was obtained by Garfiel, and Garfiel discovered the "suicide note" written by Otto.

value.title: Re:Zero - Starting Break Time from Zero: Witch's Tea Confectionery
value.synopsis: Emilia and Echidna were walking in the forest. Echidna pretended to be strong and said that she could keep up with Emilia's pace, but in the end she collapsed on the ground due to exhaustion.

value.title: Re:Zero - Starting Break Time from Zero: Days Waiting for the Gospel
value.synopsis: Betty recalls her happy times in the Forbidden Library, especially her conversation with José.

value.title: Re:Zero - Starting Break Time from Zero: Otto's Diary - 9
value.synopsis: Subaru, Otto, and Garfiel have a post-war discussion.

value.title: Re:Zero - Starting Break Time from Zero: Diary of the Dark Work Sisters - 2
value.synopsis: Roswaal and Elsa make a deal, and then Elsa and Merry talk about Roswaal.

value.title: Re:Zero - Starting Break Time from Zero: Otto's Diary - 10
value.synopsis: Ram expressed that she didn't care about Otto's existence. In order to change his image in Ram's mind, Otto gave a "speech".

value.title: Re:Zero - Starting Break Time from Zero: The Stone of the Miracle, the Path to the Miracle
value.synopsis: Ram summoned the great elf Puck, and the two discussed Ram's belief - Lord Roswaal.

value.title: Re:Zero - Starting Break Time from Zero: Witches' Tea Party
value.synopsis: The witches all praised Emilia's performance in the trial, and then at the tea party, they teased about the relationship between Echidna and Natsuki Subaru.

value.title: Re:Zero - Starting Break Time from Zero: Meili's Diary
value.synopsis: Merry questions Elsa's remarkable healing ability, and Elsa explains why she possesses it.

value.title: Re:Zero - Starting Break Time from Zero: Otto's Diary - 11
value.synopsis: Frandelica watched Garfiel and Otto conversing outside the door, and told Petra that she was a little jealous of Otto, who had such a good relationship with Garfiel. Then, in a very cute way, Petra helped the siblings.
